## Summary

Describe the change and its motivation.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run notice` (if dependencies changed)

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] Security defaults and local-only behavior are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, or production model sources are included.
- [ ] Documentation, links, and status labels are accurate.
